description: Ministry of Pubic Administration - Appointed of National Delimitation Committee
reasoning: This gazette content is a declaration regarding the appointment of a National Delimitation Committee on Demarcation of Wards for Local Authorities. The notification specifically references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and establishes a committee responsible for electoral boundary changes. This falls squarely under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with electoral processes and the appointment of an electoral commission committee, not government personnel changes or structural modifications.
